name: treats an already-active account as a no-op

steps.title: Close Steam
steps.detail: Skipped: Steam is already signed in as this account, so it is left running.

steps.title: Back up Steam files
steps.detail: Skipped: nothing will be modified.

steps.title: Mark the account as most recent
steps.detail: No change: user_1 is already the most recent account in loginusers.vdf.

steps.title: Point Steam at the account
steps.detail: No change: AutoLoginUser is already user_1.

steps.title: Keep the session remembered
steps.detail: Skipped: no switch is needed, so the value is left as it is.

steps.title: Start Steam
steps.detail: Start Steam normally. It signs in as user_1 without prompting because the session is remembered.

steps.title: Wait for Steam to come up
steps.detail: Poll the process list until steam.exe is running, up to 0.04 s.

steps.title: Confirm Steam signed in
steps.detail: Poll until Steam reports the signed-in account id 39734273 (the SteamID3 of user_1), up to 0.04 s. Meanwhile {tmp}\steam\logs\steamui_login.txt is read (Steam's own sign-in state log, no credentials in it) to learn at once whether Steam is instead asking for a password or a Steam Guard code, and {tmp}\steam\logs\bootstrap_log.txt (its updater log) to see whether Steam is updating itself first; then the wait starts over when the update ends, up to 15 min in all. A game launch (steam://rungameid/<appid>) happens only after the sign-in is confirmed.

steps.title: Fallback: sign in with the stored password
steps.detail: Not available: no password is stored for this account. If Steam asks for credentials, One Launch waits for you to sign in by hand (next step).

steps.title: Wait for you to sign in
steps.detail: Runs only if Steam still asks for something One Launch cannot supply: a Steam Guard code for a PC this account has not used before, an expired session with no stored password, or a session Steam simply refuses. The Steam window stays open on its sign-in form; you sign in there once with "Remember me" ticked and One Launch continues with the game as soon as Steam reports the sign-in, up to 0.0006666666666666666 min. A wrong stored password ends the switch instead.

notes: Steam is already set to sign in as user_1. The real switch would change nothing.
